title.en: Courage Is Built in the Arena.
title.zh: 勇气是在场上练出来的。

subtitle.en: A speech-style read-aloud lesson for practicing conviction, action vocabulary, and a stronger public voice.
subtitle.zh: 一篇演讲感跟读课，练习信念、行动词汇和更有力量的公共表达。

note.en: Public-domain speech inspiration for the idea that effort, risk, and participation matter more than distant criticism.
note.zh: 公开领域演讲灵感来源，强调努力、风险和参与比远处批评更重要。

warmup.en: Stand or sit taller before reading. This passage needs a grounded voice: slower than excitement, stronger than hesitation.
warmup.zh: 朗读前坐直或站稳。这篇需要一种扎实的声音：比兴奋更慢，比犹豫更有力。

intro.en: This original passage borrows the moral energy of classic public speeches without reproducing them. Read it as a short address to someone who wants courage but fears being judged.
intro.zh: 这篇原创稿借鉴经典公共演讲的精神力量，但不复刻原文。朗读时想象你在对一个想勇敢、但害怕被评价的人说话。

sections.text: It is always easier to judge from a distance. From the edge of the room, every decision looks simple. Every mistake looks avoidable. Every delay looks like weakness. But the person who is actually doing the work knows another truth. Real effort is crowded with incomplete information, tired bodies, imperfect timing, and the strange loneliness of choosing before the result is visible. Courage does not mean we feel certain. It means we step forward while uncertainty is still in the room, take responsibility for what we can see, and keep learning from what we could not see yet.

coaching.en: Give weight to easier to judge from a distance, then slow down for the list of real pressures.
coaching.zh: easier to judge from a distance 要读得有分量，然后在真实压力的列举里放慢。

sections.text: Participation has a cost. If you speak, someone may misunderstand you. If you build, something may break. If you lead, you may discover that your first plan was too small, too proud, or simply wrong. Still, there is dignity in being willing to revise in public. The strongest people are not the ones who never look foolish. They are the ones who can be corrected without collapsing, challenged without becoming bitter, and seen without pretending to be finished. They carry their mistakes as material, not as a permanent sentence against themselves.

coaching.en: Use a firm rhythm on If you speak, if you build, if you lead. Make each clause land.
coaching.zh: If you speak, if you build, if you lead 要读出坚定节奏，每个分句都落地。

sections.text: A useful life cannot be organized around applause. Applause is pleasant, but it arrives late and leaves early. Criticism can be useful, but it often arrives with noise attached. So we need an inner standard: Did I prepare honestly? Did I listen when reality pushed back? Did I protect the people who trusted me? Did I become more truthful because of this work? These questions are not glamorous, but they are durable. They help us stay upright when praise makes us dizzy and when criticism makes us small.

coaching.en: Read the four questions with enough space for the listener to answer silently.
coaching.zh: 四个问题之间留一点空间，让听众能在心里回答。

sections.text: At the end of the day, courage returns us to the work. Not to the fantasy of perfect performance, and not to the comfort of endless analysis, but to the next honest action. Make the call. Rewrite the paragraph. Apologize clearly. Try the second version. Ask for help without making yourself smaller. The arena is not a place for heroes only. It is the ordinary space where a person practices becoming more responsible than afraid. And that practice, repeated quietly, becomes character.

coaching.en: Make the short action sentences direct and clean. Finish repeated quietly, becomes character with calm strength.
coaching.zh: 几个短行动句要直接、干净。最后 repeated quietly, becomes character 要沉稳有力。

meaning.en: A place where action, conflict, or public effort happens.
meaning.zh: 行动、冲突或公开努力发生的场域。

use.en: The arena is where courage becomes real.
use.zh: arena 是勇气变真实的地方。

meaning.en: A strong belief that guides action.
meaning.zh: 能指导行动的坚定信念。

use.en: Speak with conviction, but leave room to learn.
use.zh: 说话要有信念，但也要留出学习空间。

meaning.en: To change and improve something after learning more.
meaning.zh: 在学到更多之后修改、改进。

use.en: There is dignity in being willing to revise in public.
use.zh: 愿意在公开场合修正自己，是有尊严的。

meaning.en: To fall apart emotionally, physically, or structurally.
meaning.zh: 情绪上、身体上或结构上崩掉。

use.en: You can be corrected without collapsing.
use.zh: 你可以接受修正，而不必崩溃。

meaning.en: Strong enough to last over time.

use.en: Durable questions keep us steady under pressure.
use.zh: 持久的问题能让我们在压力下稳定。

meaning.zh: 稳定、诚实、有内在支撑的。

use.en: An inner standard helps us stay upright.
use.zh: 内在标准帮助我们站得住。

pronunciationFocus.en: Practice strong sentence openings: It is always easier, Participation has a cost, A useful life.
pronunciationFocus.zh: 练习有力量的句首：It is always easier, Participation has a cost, A useful life。

pronunciationFocus.en: Keep the consonant clusters clear in strange loneliness, strongest people, and endless analysis.
pronunciationFocus.zh: strange loneliness, strongest people, endless analysis 的辅音组合要清楚。

pronunciationFocus.en: Let action verbs land: speak, build, lead, make, rewrite, apologize, try, ask.
pronunciationFocus.zh: 让行动动词落地：speak, build, lead, make, rewrite, apologize, try, ask。

prompt.en: Practice this like a short speech. Your goal is not speed; your goal is authority with warmth.
prompt.zh: 把它当短演讲练。目标不是快，而是有权威感，同时有温度。

steps.en: Pass one: copy the audio and mark every sentence where the voice becomes stronger.
steps.zh: 第一遍：跟音频，标出声音变强的句子。

steps.en: Pass two: read only the action sentences and make them clean, not dramatic.
steps.zh: 第二遍：只读行动句，读得干净，不要演过头。

steps.en: Pass three: replace one example with your own work or parenting situation.
steps.zh: 第三遍：把一个例子换成你自己的工作或养育场景。

reflection.en: Where in your life are you judging from a distance instead of participating?
reflection.zh: 你生活里哪里还在远远评价，而不是亲自参与？

reflection.en: What is one next honest action you can take this week?
reflection.zh: 这周你可以做的一个诚实的下一步是什么？
